newsitem.title: USA: Unocal says it no longer fits API profile.
newsitem.headline: Unocal says it no longer fits API profile.

text.p: Unocal Corp, explaining its recent decision to withdraw from the American Petroleum Institute, said it no longer fits the oil industry lobbying group's membership profile.
"Our focus has evolved and changed, and with the sale of our downstream assets to Tosco and our overseas focus, we no longer fit the API membership profile," said Barry Lane.
Unocal's withdrawal is effective December 31, he said.
The company would not comment on the amount of money it will save from leaving the group.
API recently lost another member, Sun Co Inc, which said it would leave the group at the end of this year as part of its effort to cut costs.
